pairs.registryProposal: The standard expects either a derived-and-served pipeline for document corpora or a reviewed-and-committed string catalog. Clarify the standard's fallback rules for desktop/client-side applications: in client runtimes with async section chunks, key-level fallback via deep-merge is used to prevent blank UI controls, which directly conflicts with the strict whole-unit fallback prohibition ('never splice').
